patches.subject: use new SdpAttributeListImpl for webrtc-sdp;r=mjf

features.summary: Firefox reorganized its WebRTC session-description code around reusable implementations for SDP documents, media sections, and attribute lists, instead of relying on older SIPCC-specific versions. It also converted bandwidth handling to the shared webrtc-sdp model, making session negotiation more consistent and easier to maintain.

features.label: WebRTC web API (RTCPeerConnection)

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Fix various bugs, and cleanup, in frame handling.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Tighten up spec compliance in InsertDTMF.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Don't let a re-gather discard a pending StartIceChecks.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Propagate setCodecPreferences() to the send track.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Support early media reception for bundled recvonly/sendrecv transceivers.

features.summary: Firefox improved RTCPeerConnection, the WebRTC API used to set up real-time audio and video connections, with cleaner and more reliable video-frame handling. It now follows the specification more closely for InsertDTMF, preserves pending ICE connectivity checks during re-gathering, applies setCodecPreferences() to outgoing tracks, and can receive early media from bundled transceivers before negotiation fully settles.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Use the pending offer's RTP extensions when building the early-media demux filter.
